messages:
Jordan (AE): FYI — Petrum is asking for a bundle of compliance artifacts for the POC: SOC 2 Type II report, ISO scope doc, and a signed pen-test letter they can show procurement. Can someone own delivery?
Sam W. (Solutions): I can run the handoff. Quick Q: do they need full reports or redacted copies for the POC?
Jordan (AE): They said "enough for procurement to sign off" — I think redacted is fine but they specifically asked for an official pen-test attestation they can present.
Nina (InfoSec): We usually provide redacted SOC2 and an ISO scope PDF; full evidence requires an NDA. For pen-test letter we can provide the vendor attestation template signed by us + scope summary.
Priya (Legal): @Nina +1. Also prefer limited-scope wording in the pen-test letter — no unconstrained access to customer environments. I can draft the language.
Sam W. (Solutions): Great. I'll prepare a "proof pack" tar with: `SOC2-summary.pdf`, `ISO-27001-scope.pdf`, `pen-test-attestation.pdf`, and `staging-access-README.md`. I'll drop it to the secure SFTP we use for evidence handoffs.
Jordan (AE): ETA from customer side: they want the package within 72 hours to keep the POC scheduling.
Nina (InfoSec): We can meet 72h if Legal signs off on the pen-test wording today. Also we need to confirm whether Petrum will require cryptographic key flow docs (KMS) — that one may be redacted.
Priya (Legal): I'll put a redline in the attestation to include: scope, date range, and statement that this is an attestation of a third-party test, not a production-level access grant. I can do it in 2 hours.
AuditBot: Automated note: Evidence bundle checklist created — ID EB-2024-0917. Folder path (internal): `s3://redwood-evidence/handovers/EB-2024-0917/`
Sam W. (Solutions): Thanks. For SFTP drop: use `sftp.redwood-infra.com` -> user `evidence+2410076550`. Example:```bash
sftp evidence@ sftp.redwood-infra.com:/incoming/petrum-2410076550
# then put EB-2024-0917.tar.gz
```
Sam W. (Solutions): Also including minimal instructions in staging README for test accounts: `staging_user: poc-readonly@example.com` and note that KMS keys are not shared.
Jordan (AE): Heads up — Petrum also asked whether Dedicated (reserved capacity) pricing will affect SLA in the POC. They want a ballpark number to evaluate total cost. Can we include a line item?
Sam W. (Solutions): I can add a separate pricing note: "POC estimate (ephemeral dedicated): $X/day — final based on GPU type & hours". Keep it high-level only. No contracts in handoff.
Nina (InfoSec): One more: they requested evidence of vulnerability scanning frequency. We can provide scanning cadence and summary of last external scan date (redacted findings). AuditBot, can you pull last external scan date?
AuditBot: Last external vuln scan: 2024-11-08. Summary doc path: `s3://redwood-evidence/scans/2024-11-08-external-summary.pdf`
Priya (Legal): Jordan — please confirm with Petrum whether an NDA is signed. If not, we'll only send redacted artifacts and the pen-test attestation with limited detail.
Jordan (AE): They have an inbound NDA request in DocuSign but not yet executed. I'll ping them and push for signature today.
Sam W. (Solutions): Plan: Priya drafts attestation -> Nina approves -> I assemble bundle -> drop to SFTP with AuditBot ticket -> Jordan confirms NDA -> we share link.
Nina (InfoSec): Approving in principle. If we need faster transfer and NDA still pending, we can share a watermarked PDF via secure link (one-time view).
Priya (Legal): Draft uploaded to `gdrive:/Legal/PenTest_Attestations/Petrum_draft_v1.docx`. I'll flag when ready.
Jordan (AE): Ok team — thanks. I'll update Petrum: expect redacted SOC2 + ISO scope + signed pen-test attestation within 48-72h pending NDA. Will loop back when DocuSign completes. :thumbsup:
Sam W. (Solutions): Copy. I'll start assembling once Priya flags the final doc.
Nina (InfoSec): FYI — if the customer insists on raw finding details, we'll escalate to Compliance review; that will push timeline to >2 weeks.
Jordan (AE): Noted. I'll keep that as fallback. Closing the loop after NDA.
AuditBot: Ticket EB-2024-0917 created and assigned to Sam W. Status: open.
